title: Slot grid and booking UI
idea: The frontend shows a court's hourly grid, lets the player pick neighbouring hours, and sends one idempotent booking request per click, however often the network fails.
points: The page owns server data; SlotGrid owns the pick, its step and an error.
The API client makes one Idempotency-Key per click and reuses it on retries.
A 409 clears the pick; onTaken tells the page to refetch the grid.
Follow-up: cache the grid briefly at scale; the unique index still guards writes.

messages.label: book(C-1, 18:00, 1h)
messages.note: The player clicks Book. The button disables and the step becomes SUBMITTING.

messages.label: POST /bookings + key ik-1
messages.note: The client makes one Idempotency-Key for this click. A second click gets the same promise.

messages.label: create(ik-1, body)
messages.note: The controller validates the body with zod, then calls the service.

messages.label: INSERT booking, slots
messages.note: One transaction inserts the PENDING booking and one row per hour.

messages.label: COMMIT
messages.note: The partial unique index accepts the 18:00 row, so the transaction commits.

messages.label: 201 BK-1 (lost)
messages.note: The reply is lost on the way back. The booking exists, but the browser does not know.

messages.label: retry with key ik-1
messages.note: The client retries with the SAME key, never a new one.

messages.label: 200 BK-1 (replay)
messages.note: The API's create call finds ik-1 already stored and returns that booking. No second booking is made.

messages.label: HELD BK-1
messages.note: The screen moves to payment with a countdown to the hold deadline.

code.title: Idempotent API client
code.caption: Pure logic with a fake server in the same file. Run it, then add 18:00 to `taken` and predict the output.

walk.text: The fake server saves by key, refuses 17:00, and loses its first reply.
While a request is in flight, another click returns the same promise.
One key per click; every retry of that click sends the same key.
Map the response to the next screen step: held, taken, or error.
Book 18:00 with a double click, then try 17:00, which is taken.

code.title: SlotGrid component
code.caption: A React component that renders state and calls the client. Not run here.

walk.text: Props bring server data and the client; local state is the pick, the step and an error.
SUBMITTING disables the button on the next render; the client's shared promise covers clicks before then.
A 409 clears the pick, shows why, and calls onTaken so the parent refetches the grid.
Any other error status stays here with a message; only success goes to payment.
A network failure after retries returns to selecting with a message.
Loading and empty states are explicit, never a blank grid.
Picks stay contiguous up to three hours; the button shows progress.

pitfalls: Reuse the Idempotency-Key on retries; a new key after a lost reply gets a false 409.
Show prices from the server response, not only the client's preview.
Follow-up: weekly bookings become several bookings created in one transaction.

quiz.q: What does bookingClient print for the 18:00 status line?
options: status 409 -> TAKEN: refresh grid, pick again
quiz.why: The first try saved BK-1 but lost the reply. The retry sends the same key, so the server replays BK-1 with 200.

takeaway: One click, one key, many retries: the server books once.
